title: Patch: a Unit token sent into a deck is reported as gone, not shuffled in, and a Unit-token card cannot be traded, so no Trade ends in fatigue
notes: Issue #4821: a Unit token R11 ends on its way into a deck with room is reported libraryOverflow ceased, never shuffledIn, with no arrival hooks (draw::into_library, R4821000); a Unit-token card cannot be Traded (trade::why_trade_refused's last check, R4821001), so no Trade's draw fatigues; a ceased card reads 'Ceased to exist' on the pile and in the log (R4821002). Engine change; the catalog is untouched, so the cards are claimed with --plays. Classify stage 2 against the base build finds meditative-039, meditative-100, stinkyscape-012 and stinkyscapeplus-133 play differently (in their games a Unit token sent into a deck with room was reported shuffled in), and no rule.

player.title: A Unit token sent into a deck ceases to exist, and Unit-token cards cannot be Traded
fixes: A Unit token shuffled into a deck no longer shows as going in: it ceases to exist, and the deck pile shows "Ceased to exist".
A Unit-token card can no longer be Traded, so a Trade never puts its player into fatigue.
